text: Starting to get frustrated with this game now. Unless you buy gems, its pretty useless. You need energy to deliver orders, it takes 2 min to get 1 energy which is pointless. you need quite a bit of energy to meet an order. the in game missions are impossible unless you spend a lot in the game. I like playing rhe game but the downtime waiting for energy is frustrating and obvious creators care more about profit than gameplay.

Simply fun merging game. It's very addictive as it keeps me playing every few hours. The storyline is interesting but definitely not at all like what it advertised. New events every month. The graphic is cool and not too glaring. It is not a very hard game to play for any beginner to merge game. The only reason I give 4☆ is that the fact it can be quite expensive to keep buying stuff for this game. It feels like it is impossible to complete the card collection without breaking your piggy.

nice game that can be played without purchasing anything. the challenges change regularly and keep you interested, there are many ways to earn free coins and energy and the graphics are nice. However there are far, far too many pop ups when you open the game, the storyline got boring several levels back and certain items take forever to merge such as seafood for which you first make a platter of before making the dishes.

It is a well made game, but impossible to play as you level up. it is basically a money pit. You get 3 hourly energy refill for 2 minutes of play. the energy cannot even make a jug of tea. If you must play the game at a somewhat faster pace, you will have to spend a lot of money daily. Feels like a chore as I cannot play it to relax due to waiting endlessly for energy refill. I'm really not enjoying it at this point

Since the introduction of "dazzling cards", it's become near impossible to make full sets. It was hard before but now it's shocking. They've also increased purchase prices by at least 50% so it's no longer affordable. I'm deleting it. Addictive game so don't bother with it.

Update 21 Mar 2026...I used to like the way it looked, but it seems to have changed today, and it looks "colder" in some way, not as friendly. I'm ashamed to say that I've spent money on this app, and now I don't think I like it anymore :( ________ The game was fun until I got to level 80-ish. You can't complete orders very often because it takes so much energy to create the more advanced things. It's not very enjoyable anymore. oh, and it's nothing like the ad!

bottomless money pit! started off great, good story and able to watch ads to gain extra energy. HOWEVER as soon as you start rising in levels the ads disappear so you can't gain energy that way. The story is stretched out to the point it becomes boring - it's clear they have done this to just keep you paying. The items you merge get higher but free energy remains the same so you can only continue playing if you spend money. very disappointed.

It's actually a decent game. But, the advertising is deceptive. I've not seen a single advert that is similar to the real gameplay. I'm not sure why they did that. Also, whilst you are not being punted off to watch external ads all the time the internal pressure to spend money on loot boxes is quite obnoxious. I like the story a lot. But eventually realised it's just not worth the amount I was spending.

okay but there is better games. story is so bad that it's good, real soap opera style, and ridiculous reactions really. but when you've tapped what you can do, if you don't want to pay money there is nothing to keep you. other similar, if you just stay idle in the game you can progress still but sloooow, like an item or coin will pop occasionally, so you might find yourself just losing interest.

saw the advert, wanted to play the game depicted in the advert so installed and game completely different. !!!!! Update the game may be good, lots of good reviews but it doesn't replicate the advert that tempts you to download it. perhaps the level depicted might be level 1001 but not the first few levels that you encounter initially

Do not spend money in the game. I think the game is fantastic... been playing it for a couple of years, and the storyline, side quests, characters, and graphics are great. Recently, however, I spent money for the first time. Big mistake. The energy box you could get by watching an ad now permanently costs 10 gems; and what you get inside is just blues and purples. You only get one lot of 15 energy with an ad. You only get one item free from an ad. Very poor way to treat your customers.

Not a "game" person but found this cute & fun, but only if you spend lots of💰. The number of items available for free from the 🛒 aren't consistant & the number of times you get 15⚡️free in exchange for watching a video, also changes. Sometimes only once, sometimes 5 times. I know the app is to make 💰 for the developers etc, but you don't get a chance to see what it's like or to see if it's worth spending 💰on. App also stalls alot & won't open now. Not sure why but it ruins the experience.

This is a great dopamine boosting game for those with ADHD however, I hate that your rewards dont match the levels, making it impossible to play for any longer than 1 minute unless you spend a fortune on 'energy'. Well, you've lost one customer. Yes charge for extras / for things to happen quicker but not to simply just play a standard game. Now to find one I can enjoy for longer periods without spending a fortune.

I've just deleted this app after a few months of playing. It's impossible to complete any of the quests in full, even when making regular purchases, which aren't cheap either!! Theres a lot better games out there and i won't be falling into this scam trap any more. Disgusted with myself for how much I've spent and i still can't complete a simple quest in full!! Don't waste your time, once you level up it's just impossible to do any task at all without spending actual money.

There are much better and cheaper games out there! I read many players complaining about the issue, but i can't see any changes! Sadly not what i thought it would be. Ad was lying free prices worth $100. There is no chance to finish the orders and win the side games if you don't spend money! Most orders can take days,by that time, the events are over, and you don't win prices! The diamonds increase for buying energy, but you get the energy amount stays the same!

Firstly, it's NOT the game advertised. Very quickly use the resources required to play, so either have to spend lots of money to continue or wait an hour or for things to fill up. Once full, it takes around 2-3 minutes to use them all again (and I am only on level 5, so will use quicker in higher levels). Nothing to do while waiting for coins and energy. It's a merge game so very monotonous.

I really wanted to like this game. First of all, the only scene you get from the adverts is the opening casino scene. Other than that, the adverts are a lie. Shocking, I know(!) Secondly, it takes way too much energy to make the simplest of things. Yes, you can use gems to buy more, but that starts at 20 gems! However, there are no ads in-game, so i suppose that's something

1 star because it is fun to play Without spending, you get all of about half hour gameplay a day, if that. You get 1 energy point every 2 minutes and it's capped at 100 points, and you need a good 400+ points to do the bigger orders.. To actually enjoy this game, you have to spend every other day. and honestly, it gets expensive when it all adds up. Also the more you spend, the more the prices seem to go up.

I really want to love this game cause I adore the artstyle and the storyline is interesting, but what gets me is the sleezy way that they up the number of gems you need to buy more energy. It starts with 20 gems for 100energy which makes you assume if you buy 100 gems you'd be able to refill up to 500 energy, but nope, it goes up from 20 to 40 to 80. I think I saw 160 at some point too... It's misleading and sleazy practice. I don't feel confident about what I'm spending on. Just fair warning!!!

Was looking for a game to kill few minutes during daily commute. This Game it's well made in terms of graphic. Unfortunately playing is really boring. I didn't pay for it, played few days reaching lv 15. The main game it's too repetitive, you always cook the same dishes and you don't see any progress. Side games gave a bit more entertainment, but not enough to keep my interests or spend $$Dialogues are too long, at some point I start skipping them, i was only interested in choosing decoration 😅

This game aesthetically is super fun, I'm at about level 25 now and unless you pay to play you literally can't make progress at a good rate. It can take days to fill customers orders with the higher level merges thus slowing down earning coins to continue the story. May I add, I check in a few times a day once energy has replenished and its still not enough. You need to fix this, it's not fair for longer term players, nor can you fully complete an event because you just don't have enough time.

I have been playing this for a long time (now level 152) and still enjoying it the plotline, gameplay and characters. The new 'bonus' function where you get a higher level item at random is a great addition. I have spent some money but if I'd had a bit more patience I wouldn't have had to 😅 I just wish there was some way to look back whenever you like at the objects from the plotlines, like the paintings and the clues. Please consider this for future? Thank you!

Addicting but a rip off. 1. it is absolutely nothing like the ad!! 2. you get 100 free tokens (can't remember what they actually are) to merge the items. It can take hundreds of tokens to make 1 item. so you either wait hours to generate another 100 tokens to play for 2 minutes or use gems to buy tokens, which are very hard to build up enough of, so you must buy them for ridiculous prices. The amount of gems needed goes up each time you buy tokens but you get the same amount of tokens each time.

I've spent a lot of time and money on this game. Pros - It's the best merge game on the market. It's smooth, fast responding and easy to use. It offers a variety of boosters and gifts that definitely help you along the way. It isn't too easy, nor too challenging. Cons - Some of the items are valued way too high. 200 to over 1000 diamonds is ridiculous, considering how much energy it costs to produce these items, only for duplicates to cost so much. Especially seafood.

Would rate higher if they did not force you to do every event. Also, I have experienced the game being rigged to give me the opposite items of what I need so I use up all my energy points and/or gems. It should be randomized as right now it's quite manipulative. They have been generous (at least on the early levels) with continuing the story which sets it apart from other games in the category.

to be able to play for more than 5 minutes at a time you need to pay. 100 energy is gone before you have enough items to fill an order. have spent way too much and will probably uninstall as its not sustainsble. need a better way to get gems and energy. also some of the bubbles require 600 gems a time to pop the item. fun but too expensive to play..

impossible to contact support if you have an issue. You need to take a screen shot ridiculous. When you do not accept a reward. Once some challenges have been completed, they disappear, so you cannot screen shot. The game is quick enough to accept your payment, but their is no support when you are not happy. I enjoy the game, but sadly, I won't be playing anymore out of principle.

Very nice game, story seems good. But a big frustration for me is how much energy it takes to fulfil even 1 order. The progress is way too slow and I'm only on day 9. Please do something to make the game progress a bit faster. I'm now on the fence to get the game uninstalled because of the amount of time it takes and less rewards for doing so. But I like the game overall.

1. I've seen better graphics. 2. you can only progress if you buy coins for money. I understand this is how the developers earn their money, but this way playing the game feels like going to work. You get a little payment(energy) time by time, that you spend very quickly, and you didn't progress much. It's not entertaining, it's torturing.

AVOID: IN-APP PURCHASE BORE! Advert is nothing like game. You can't progress in this game unless you're prepared to spend £1,000's to buy gems to power up, but sold unfairly eg. 1st=10, doubling each time, as do gem prices but less bonus as you go. High level generators still kick out lowest level items eg. 2048 units for 1 item, only recharging to 100 max after 3 hours. So, 3mins play/day unless you pay. Totally skewed against player. Developer responses to feedback says it all.🙄 UNINSTALLED.

Really loved this game to begin with but as you get above level 15 it becomes impossible to actually play for more than about a minute every few hours without spending money for more energy. The orders themselves start to take maybe 300+ points each and you only get 100 at a time before it needs to refill. The packs are really quite expensive and don't even give you that much energy - around $4 for another minutes worth of game play! Also nothing like the ad. Overall fun but not worth it.

Started playing a while back as it was advertised on another game and it's quite addictive, the game is really chilled and fun to play, however the story seems to have changed since the update which I find kind of annoying, it's gone from a fire to food poisoning for some reason. I still didn't find out who started the fire, damn you. There is still an issue with advert rewards as they don't work half the time. Other than that it's a great game.

overall disheartening Great when you first start but the higher you get the harder it becomes but not in a fun way. Events are now almost impossible to complete due to limited energy and higher demands without spending a lot of cash, despite logging in several times a day to use what little energy you gain over time. It is supposed to be fun not a full time job. And I suppose I will get the same stock answer from them that everyone else has got so they are not really interested at all ...

I love playing this game for it's simplicity. Just merging 2 of the same images together and slowly you can build up to a bigger item. The game revolves around renovating a restaurant, you can follow the story between the characters if you want. Each level involves serving food you merge to customers who give you money which you use to decorate another part of the restaurant. I wasn't overly keen on the reactions of the characters or the pressure to need to buy in order to progress.

Started playing enjoyed the concept and the merge hasn't been too difficult, like the ads from other games say I've not been hit by any ads yet. What I do have a problem with is the ever increasing cost of gems to top up your energy, it's starts of at 20 then 40 I'm currently at 80 gems. So be prepared to splash the cash to keep going with the storyline. Also installed the game from one of the ads with the fake CEO and never got the promised £100 worth of free goodies. Total rip off.

I've been playing this as part of an earn to play app. It's addictive, relaxing, doesn't take much brain power to play. I'm not bothered about the characters&storyline so just skip through that part. An add for it popped up while I was playing a different game-said it was "the game where mum&daughter are out in the snow-its so fulfilling to help them". It's not this game at all and I don't understand the need to lie so that's why it's lost 2*. Otherwise a good game to pass some time.

Nice concept and simple bright graphics but it's very slow moving and not really worth playing, it takes a day to complete any tasks, but that is 20 minutes gaming and the rest of the time, is spent waiting for the game tokens to power up. It's very focused on selling, hence why it's designed to take so long. It needs to add 500 power tokens, not 100, and these need to be refreshed by 2 every 30 seconds, not 1 every 2 minutes. This would help speed up the game.

I love this game but its virtually impossible to play without spending money and the longer I've been playing the harder it is to complete events and the more you are pushed to spend. The mini games start off with high rewards but as they get towards the end of the time the playing pieces suddenly become really hard to come by and the mini game is impossible to complete without paying out (and even then its not anywhere near gaurenteed).

I'd give it 0 stars if i could. I downloaded it from an ad on another game. The ad stated the game was exactly like the ad, where you help a mum and daughter who have fallen on hard times and you help repair their home. The game is NOTHING LIKE THAT. You help her fix up a diner. The ad also promised $100 worth of free content, which was not there. Also note the ads are EXACTLY the same as the Seaside Escape ad. It's false advertising and should be reported. Uninstalled.

You never get enough energy or chances to win more so you can only play it for a matter of a few minutes at a time before you've run out again. It's far too difficult to move through the levels and I found myself obsessively using it at random times to use the standard 100 energy so it would build up again when I was busy. The satisfaction level is not high enough to keep on playing it. There are certain items that are too difficult to get and you end up wasting all your energy trying.

Updated. After a long break I reinstalled.There are still in app purchases but it appears they aren't as bad as they were before. I dont feel like I am stuck in the story for days at a time unless I opt to pay for gems etc. I dont mind paying for in app items but after a certain point it would really be wonderful if it unlocked the full game and removed all purchase options after you have paid a certain amount or something. Perhaps offering only rare and exclusive items after? Just an idea.

Avoid!!! This game is impossible to play without getting sucked into micro-payments. Even when you pay for progress with chests and perks, the game gets harder to be successful at. The rewards hinder and don't help. I paid for a "VIP" event & the game made it too difficult to reap the rewards. Attempting to make progress, even when paying, is futile. The actual "story" is painfully slow to progress and not interesting enough to engage the gamer and the protagonist isn't likeable. Disappointing.

Stingy with the energy When buying with gems, you should be able to get more than 100 energy at a time. The cost of energy doubles each time — first 10 gems for 100 energy, then it doubles for the same amount. Why? Energy should refill after finishing a level, not just give a small 40-energy box. I get that the goal is to encourage spending, but it feels too limiting, especially with so many levels to create on the items, some have up to 15.

I don't like Cole. Quinn annoys me sometimes cus wdym a quick conversation is all it takes to rule people out, just to put them back on the list again? A lot of drama over what feels like nothing, despite the actual stakes. That being said, I feel I've reached a good balance with game. A lot of buttons to push and little things to prolong the gameplay loop a little longer, and when you get down to zero energy, take that as the sign to close the app and go do something else for a while.

Too difficult to progress. Not enough energy and too few opportunities to increase energy through game play. Certain items will consume all energy in one sitting. I'm not even that deep into the game yet either. Other merge games allow for much longer play time. This one gives you a few minutes max before running out of energy. Sadly the first merge game I am going to uninstall.

Game is relaxing, and is the only one I play, and I really enjoy it. However there is a lot of pop ups one after another which get annoying. It would also be nice if there wasn't so many events running at once. I'm at a fairly high level and I usually use all my energy trying to do part of an order, things like the fish is soul destroying if your order is the last one. Also most games refill energy when you level up, this one doesn't.

Very fun but it really limits you to only playing for around 10-15 minutes at a time because there's no energy boosts. Usually with other similar games you get an energy boost when you level up but that's not the case in this game which is a shame. Otherwise really good game and no ads and very fun! Just can't give it the 5 stars because of there being no way other than paying to get energy quicker!

It's actually a really good fun game - but similar to what others have said, you have to wait so long to make the item you want to make unless you spend some real money..other items seem very rare to obtain e.g. items for updating the generators in able to merge the two together which means I'm still stuck with level 4 bread generator because there are literally never any bags coming out of special chests e.g. and so on.. I've even spent £10 on super pass including the gems...

I did enjoy this game but just about to uninstall after a long streak. It seems you can only do well and progress at a reasonable speed if you spend...and when you spend, there isn't anything you have unlocked for the game permanently. I've kinda hit a brick wall with it, spent about £15 all in and nothing to show for it really. Pointless.

It's an absolute scam. The game bears zero resemblance to what's advertised and it's completely unplayable for longer than a few minutes without constantly having to pay more and more money. It's ruinously expensive and the return you get for the exponentially increasing amounts of cash you have to hand over is a joke. You have to keep paying and paying every few MINUTES. I deleted it, it's daylight robbery.

loved this game but as you progress the rewards for completing tasks get lower whilst the levels demand much more energy to be used to complete. Unless you're prepared to wait hours for energy to restore, you are forced to buy energy to continue. Also certain items like fries, tea and scuba equipment are very difficult to get and others, like shells or fish are easy. very annoying when you have to merge lots of cups of coffee just to get a few T bags.

You know that game that the ads look great but the game is completely different. This is how the ad starts and says this game is exactly like the ads, it isn't. The ads are nothing like the game and as you progress it takes all your energy for one order, impossible to play for more than 5 minutes without paying. Shame as the game is quite fun, if the ads showed what it actually was and it was less pay heavy I would have kept it

Honestly, this game is super cute and fun to play.. it is however being ruined by all the money grab pop ups - sometimes 5 or 6 in quick succession and also by the enormous amount of events. There are too many going at once, none of them last long enough to make a dent in and without spending real money they're impossible to finish. It's kind of ruining the game 🥲

I enjoy the game but it does frustrate me when you have to wait ages to merge items to serve to people or wait days to get items to renovate the restaurant and coins to hear the story. The board could do with being bigger as well as the items you have to hold to move forward are a lot. The place you can save your special items is expensive to buy expansions for too, why? If things cost less people would be more inclined to buy and probably more of it. Too expensive and I avoid at all cost!

I had to remove this game because it was addictive: in an attempt to get the deck of cards, I ended up spending £10 a week- sometimes more. It is a good game with a good story line, but play it without buying anything. In any case, the complete set of cards can't be achieved unless you are ready to spend up to £20-30 a week. So one day, I had enough & I stopped altogether (gamer spending several hours a day on it). Also the guy selling it lies like he breathes. No link worth 100usd of gifts.

I like the game and have been playing it for quite a while now. A few days ago, however, something changed with the way energy can be obtained. There always used to be the option of watching one video a day to get an energy chest. That's now gone! There also used to be more chances to watch ads to replenish energy by 15. Update - I've added a star. The new break bubble feature is great and the new daily free simple pack is so much better than the picnic basket! Love it!

I really like the concept of this game and have enjoyed it, but the designers are getting greedy. If you spend at all things start to get more expensive, and the free top ups you used to be able to get with gems/coins now cost more too. I'm level 84 and honestly about ready to delete it as you just can't complete things anymore without spending. I understand this app is to make money, but give players the option to watch adverts instead and don't make it impossible to play without spending.

The game is addictive in a bad way. You'll end up spending so much money for little reward. They are constantly pushing purchases on you, and you can't progress without spending money. It's very easy for the seemingly small amounts to add up. Now i avoid all 'microfun' made games. The graphics and music are great but not worth being broke! Journey Home is a good alternative (similar vibe, but you don't *need* to buy something everytime you play or to progress. I would say AVOID this game.

It used to be quite fun, but as usual, it's turned into the rest of the games where you only get anywhere if you spend money. The two 15 extra lives, if you watch an ad, are gone. The daily specials watching an ad are gone, which contributed to maybe getting an order completed. Now, some of the orders take days to complete because of how many merges are required and how long it takes for energy to renew, so what was quite enjoyable to play in spare time has turned into far too much effort.

Pretty fun game, lots of side mini games too, but it stymies when you run out of ability to create items to merge, only way to get more and keep playing is to make purchases, which isn't ideal, slows down gameplay and makes it a bit boring. Would be nice if a few adverts would be thrown in to continue gameplay instead of continuous pay walls.

Yet another game which is nothing like the adverts! Despite seeing two adverts where the developers promise you it's the same as the adverts! Sigh! Why would it be so hard to simply make a game like the advert? I don't get it! Another game where you have to build area by area, spending money on tools to get the the next area. It's all nonsense!

I was really enjoying this game, and I've been playing for over a year. had a bug come up about 4 days ago, so uninstalled then restarted again. To find bug still there and wanted me to start all over again. wasn't happy, so uninstalled again. I really miss playing it, but dont want to start from beginning again. I'm not sure what the bug was, etc. It's such a shame I can't get it back where I left off 😕 gutted tbh .

Tedious 1 point for being ad free. To get ahead in the game you need to spend money, lots of it. Or wait for your energy to build up. 2 minutes per energy unit, and you need over 256 for some of the higher value products. Tedious To be honest the game isn't original enough to warrant spending money on it. The game bears no relation to the ad. Do yourself a favour and go out in the fresh air. MICRO fun indeed

I really enjoyed this game but as time has went on it has got very expensive to try & do the contests , the food orders and to get the energy to last very long. I decided to stop buying bundles of gems & energy and now it just seems quite boring as it takes so long to fill up. I was spending money almost everyday until I realised how silly I was being as I never got anything back for free even tho I was buying a lot.

I'm not actually going to play the game, because this is the only way I could think to spread the word about their terrible ads - and I mean for the game itself. Not only have they stolen someone else's videos (with actual actors, awful scene with a CEO yelling at his secretary??)) and simply overdubbed the name of this game (it's so obvious - awful!), they use the awful AI voices for the characters in the animated ad. I'm so sick of them I'm going to just uninstall the game, WITHOUT PLAYING!

I like this game but I've spent too much as it's too slow too create energy. 20 diamonds for 100 energy is fine but it is ridiculous for it to double for all extra energy chances. 160 diamonds for the same energy the same day is stupid. I'm finished with this game now. I actually spent about £60 in a week but now everything is more difficult to complete I'm done. You're still pressing people to pay a lot to play. 10,20,40,80 then 160! I wouldn't download this game again. Other games stop at 40.

I Went from 5 star to 1. I Went from playing constantly to not enjoying it, After level 40 the "orders" took weeks to complete for little reward. The "watch an advert to get rewards have stopped too, which helped a little" I no longer pay for extra supplies and have found another game to pass my time . Very disappointed because this was always my go to game.

I enjoy this game but the issues with the in-game purchases are getting on my nerves. I thought the new update was meant to have sorted this but still getting error messages. The game itself and the storyline are interesting at least and is the only game I am actively playing everyday. Just wish I could purchase more diamonds or items whenever I need them, instead of getting error messages.

this game is a money grab! gets to a point where it's impossible to make progress without spending alot of money. the game was great for a while then it just became all top tier items you could spend your entire energy supply on and still not be close. at this point your choice is to spend alot of money to proceed or spend days not making any progress at all and who wants to do that? a game should be fun but waiting ages to proceed is boring so deleting it. don't waste your time.

This is a fun game, I appreciate that there are no ads and you can play without feeling like you have to pay (for the gems and energy, etc.) However the reason it isn't 5 stars (and this may sound silly) is because of the storyline, it'd be nice to have at least a bit of interaction/choices for the storyline - I'm currently on level 47, and I really don't like Cole and I'd like Quinn to choose Harrison or to be single if I could make the choice.

I am sick of seeing the ad for this game. It is NOT like the ad. It's your typical merge game with the back story of fixing the business, gameplay is nothing like the ad shows. The only thing it is truthful about is no ads in the game... you just have to spend money for packs if you actually want to progress.

This is a really good game but it doesn't matter if you spend money or not you can never complete the sticker albums (this season I've had 800 double ups) makes ot impossible and can never complete the mini games inside the main game. I absolutely love the game but its not worth it anymore as you never win anything even if you do spend money!! I dont recommend anyone starts paying it unless they can be bothered to not complete anytging....ever!

The game is good until you spend your money on gems/energy packs then suddenly the game becomes a lot harder, you no longer get the daily boost of free energy which was always a help, rewards for events and cards become harder to get (cards are always repetitive) and higher level orders seem impossible to complete and can take ages due to the rubbish amount of energy you get. It's a shame it's like you get punished for spending money! I used to love the game and now it's starting to annoy me.

This is a cute merging game which I play a lot I enjoy the story line but it could be better so only 3 stars. Extra slots and double bubble items are way way too expensive so even though I've spent less than £5 on this game it's still essentially a pay to play if you want any real progress, good game could be better, the option to cut an item I had merged on accident and better prizes 4 level up. I like a challenge but I like to see some real progress too

rip off! I've spent quite a bit on this game which runs out fast. you get very close to completing the "events" or you complete some and the grand prize isn't that good. To top it off, even with gold packs, you hardly het any new cards so a couple of hours to go and I haven't completed the set. I have spent quite a bit so I don't feel it's fair. I will definitely be deleting as it is really not worth it.

As usual, the advert is totally deceiving. The game is not like as advertised. I thought I would be doing things as advertised, repairing... instead, I was fixing a bloody restaurant and matching the same items together to gain points to fix more of the restaurant for the first 7 levels. There is no harbor! BORING. UNINSTALLLED.

Purchased one of the promoted add ons and didn't receive it, even though I have the purchase receipt and the money has been taken from my bank. Tried to contact to solve and was told by a bot that they're trying to fix the issue that I caused with my purchase? Which is kinda rude. Certainly won't be purchasing anything else and I wouldn't recommend to purchase anything. Otherwise the game is ok to pass time...

fixed. I like the game itself. i just wish i could play more. im bored of waiting for energy. i get the 25 free energy daily. when it decides to update, however that is stingy. 25 energy does nothing.
